text_block_list.text:
After a display undoubtedly deserving
of the
nickname "the Beast," Нарита Брайан
wins the
Kikuka Sho and is crowned
Triple Crown
Champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Хиши Амадзон has just
become Triple
Tiara Champion. The two
of them reaffirm their
intentions to
battle at the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Нарита Брайан sets her
sights on the
Arima Kinen to settle the
score with Hishi
Amazon!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
